name: wyckoff-chart-agent
description: Chart giống TradingView + agent phân tích Wyckoff (Claude Code qua MCP) vẽ kết quả trực tiếp lên chart

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @wca/server" "npm run dev -w @wca/web"
scripts.pm2:start: npm run build:web && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.pm2:restart: npm run build:web && pm2 restart ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/mcp && tsc -p apps/web
